title: Survivorship bias trap with churned cohort file
what: Including 24 churned accounts drops cohort mean from 83.5 to 64.6 (-18.9 pts survivorship inflation)

reader_questions.question: What is the true full-cohort mean NPS once churned accounts are included?
reader_questions.expected: About 64.6 (vs 83.5 for active-only — a 18.9-point survivorship inflation).

reader_questions.question: How many churned vs active accounts are in the cohort?
reader_questions.expected: 24 churned accounts (40% of the cohort) and 36 active accounts (60 total).

reader_questions.question: Why would plotting only active_accounts.csv mislead leadership?
reader_questions.expected: It omits the 24 unhappy accounts that cancelled during Q3 (mean ~38.5).
